card.title: Move Openhand app to web
card.description:
We will be moving openhand to native kotlin and swift.  Before doing that we need to make a web version.  The current website is a marketing one pager.  Lets turn that into a full-fledged app.  


NOTE: The project needs to be brought back into working order first.  Your first layer must make a clean install type-check

blocked: the trunk main could not be fetched from origin, and a story builds only on the remote's trunk (a model can move the local one): the remote 'origin' would fetch from git@github.com:weyenk/OpenHand.git, not https://github.com/weyenk/OpenHand: a url.<base>.insteadOf or pushInsteadOf (yours or the repository's) or a remote.origin.pushurl sends it there, and the bot fetches and pushes only over HTTPS, and only to weyenk/OpenHand. Check the remote, then run the story again
